annotations.text:
DESKTOP PASS — colour/type/tone, space, the plain top button, and the back-arrow clash.

All four fixes land in one shell: a sidebar (chrome-toned, distinct from the canvas) replaces the flat top nav; Add food is promoted to a real primary button instead of a pill matching four unrelated destinations; the day-stepper moves out of the screen's leading corner — the one spot this app's real Back buttons occupy — into a bounded control with its own shape; and the freed width puts the hero and "Worth a look" side by side instead of stacked in a centred 940px column.

Working: the stepper genuinely steps (try it — the hero and macros change), "Today" jumps back, the nav rail highlights on click, and the Rajma masala row expands. "Worth a look" and the log are one illustrative day, not per-day data — the point being proven is the shell and the stepper, not a second backend.
